title: Internal Discrepancy for Contrastive Learning: Generalization Bounds and Downstream Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2610.32729v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive learning has emerged as a popular paradigm for training representation models. While prior studies pursue more practical and less restrictive assumptions to enhance theoretical understanding of contrastive learning, they essentially describe the interconnections among representations within the data or induced by the function class. To encapsulate these assumptions, we propose the measure of internal discrepancy that quantifies the difference between the mean representation of positive samples and latent cluster centers. We then prove an internal discrepancy-aware generalization bound for downstream supervised tasks following contrastive learning, without requiring additional assumptions. This generalization bound not only serves as a unifying framework connecting various assumptions but also motivates us to further reduce the internal discrepancy, thereby introducing the relaxed k-means loss as an approximation. translated_title: 对比学习的内部差异：泛化界与下游行为
translated_abstract: 对比学习已成为训练表示模型的一种流行范式。尽管先前的研究致力于寻求更实用、限制更少的假设以增强对对比学习的理论理解，但这些假设本质上描述的是数据内部表示之间或由函数类所诱导的表示之间的相互联系。为了统一概括这些假设，我们提出了“内部差异”这一度量方法，用于量化正样本的平均表示与潜在聚类中心之间的差异。随后，我们在无需额外假设的情况下，证明了对比学习之后下游监督任务的内部差异感知泛化界。这一泛化界不仅作为连接各种假设的统一框架，还激励我们进一步减小内部差异，从而引入了松弛k均值损失作为其近似。此外，
tldr: 本文提出“内部差异”度量来统一刻画对比学习中的各种理论假设，证明了基于该度量的下游监督任务泛化界，并提出松弛k均值损失作为减小内部差异的近似方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "internal discrepancy" as a unifying measure encapsulating various assumptions in contrastive learning, proves a discrepancy-aware generalization bound for downstream supervised tasks, and introduces a relaxed k-means loss to approximate and reduce internal discrepancy.
